name: heartbeat_does_not_clamp_a_later_idle_backdate
description: A heartbeat between the real last input and the confirmed idle close must not force the idle close's back-dated ts forward to the heartbeat's ts. Reproduces a production incident: real last input 14:01:33, confirmed idle 14:11:42, incorrectly reported as ending 14:07:11 (the last heartbeat) instead of 14:01:33.
